name: rawhttpy
reason: Version 0.1 accepts a raw request string, but raised ValueError on the valid CRLF request control. Converting the wire control to LF-only input would change the tested format, so it is not counted.

name: fw-http-parser
reason: Version 0.3.2 exposes HttpParser(data), but its PyPI description gives no documented local input API and the project homepage is unavailable; a local passing probe alone is insufficient.

name: httpparser
reason: Version 0.3.12 C extension failed to build on Python 3.13, 3.11, and 3.10 on this ARM host; no local control result was established.

name: aiohttp
reason: Official docs confirm an HTTP request parser but the low-level local feed_data parser API was not established as a documented public API and was not run on the control.

name: mitmproxy
reason: The project parses HTTP traffic, but a pinned documented local wire-byte API and control result were not established in this batch.

name: http-content-parser
reason: Project description covers HTTP content payloads and OpenAPI/Postman data, not HTTP/1.1 wire message parsing.

name: http-raw
reason: Documented request(raw=...) API sends a request to a remote URL and returns a response; it does not expose a local parsed-message result.

name: requests-raw
reason: Documented raw(url, data) API sends a raw request over a socket; no local parse output is documented.

name: h1client
reason: The package wraps HTTP client transport and h1parser but documents no independent local raw-message input API; h1parser is already counted.

name: http11
reason: The project name appears in the PyPI name index but has no installable release in the current registry; no release can be pinned or tested.
